fullDescription: Profile overview view for the github-user-profile-overview route in its default state. It renders the GitHub-like account header, profile sidebar, popular repositories grid, yearly contribution heatmap, and contribution activity section using the shared GithubUserProfileOverview component.

Presentational dashboard component that supports the github-home-dashboard view in its default state through typed props for user name, repository lists, feed sections, and changelog content. It provides interactive local state for search fields, toolbar selections, and repository action menus while reusing shared button, card, avatar, input, dropdown, and separator primitives.

shortDescription: Reusable GitHub profile overview screen component.
fullDescription: Presentational profile overview component for a developer account page with configurable user identity, navigation tabs, repository cards, achievements, contribution years, and contribution heatmap cells. It supports the default state through typed props and keeps the tab selection, search field, and year switcher interactive with local state while reusing shared avatar, button, card, input, and tabs primitives.
